comments.@iuv7ro8vpl9t1c260ldajuf4pa: A ticket for whichever of these tickets is ready first: await(any of(tickets)) gives its position, from 0.
comments.@sf55tacboik2ujra0am7harco2: Runs the actions side by side: each runs until it awaits a ticket, and whichever ticket is ready first goes on, until every action has its value. The values come back in the actions' order (as JavaScript's Promise.all).
comments.@1sdpr8glkafdrf1rfpqe0qpieb: Runs the actions side by side, as together does, and gives the value of the first to finish; the others are dropped where they wait (as JavaScript's Promise.race).
